newsitem.title: POLAND: POLL - Polish WIG index seen at 15,548 end-July.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Polish WIG index seen at 15,548 end-July.

text.p: The main all-share WIG index of the Warsaw bourse is seen rising to 15,548 points at the end of this month, a monthly Reuter poll of leading securities houses showed.
The average prediction for the blue-chip WIG20 index was 1,546.6 points.
The average forecast for the main WIG index at the end of the third quarter was 15.710.9 points and analysts saw it at 19,608.3 on July 31, 1998.
On July 1, the WIG closed at 15,087.9 points and the WIG20 at 1,493.2.

FORECASTS CONTRIBUTED BY: BDM PKO BP, DM PBG SA-Pekao SA Group, DM Bank Slaski SA, DM PBK SA, DM PBR SA, Creditanstalt Securities SA, Bank Zachodni SA, DM Penetrator, ING BSK Asset Management, COK Bank Handlowy SA, CBM WBK SA, CBM Pekao SA.
The forecasts were submitted on June 30.
